calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rl, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, sum(net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) staff_net, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_lines
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'

WITH f AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, sum(l.net_amount) gross_net, count(DISTINCT l.sale_date) days_sold, sum(CASE WHEN l.staff_purchase_flag THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff
 FROM fact_sales_line l JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
 WHERE l.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, sum(x.refund_net) ret, count(*) nret
 FROM fact_return_line x JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
 WHERE x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
d AS (
 SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) d_before, sum(returns_net) d_ret, sum(net_sales) d_net, count(*) d_days
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(f.store_id,r.store_id,d.store_id) sid, f.gross_net, f.days_sold, f.staff, r.ret, r.nret, d.d_before, d.d_ret, d.d_net, d.d_days
FROM f FULL JOIN r USING(store_id) FULL JOIN d USING(store_id) ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') stg_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load s WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=s.sales_line_id)) stg_not_in_fact,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_return_line_load WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') stg_ret,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_return_line_load s WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_return_line f WHERE f.return_line_id=s.return_line_id)) stg_ret_not_in_fact,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) <> sale_date) ts_date_diff,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02) vat_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)) orphan_returns,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') dup_returns,
 (SELECT max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') last_load,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to) store_version_off

calls.statement: SELECT sale_date, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-28' AND DATE '2026-07-02' AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2
),
sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.store_id
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.store_id
),
names AS (
  SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current
)
SELECT p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period,
       rank() OVER (ORDER BY round(sales.amt - coalesce(refunds.amt, 0), 2) DESC) AS rank,
       sales.store_id, names.store_name,
       round(sales.amt - coalesce(refunds.amt, 0), 2) AS net_sales
FROM sales
CROSS JOIN p
LEFT JOIN refunds USING (store_id)
JOIN names USING (store_id)
ORDER BY rank
